defensePackages.label: Hits still land, but they hurt less.
defensePackages.explanation: Flat Armor against incoming attacks. The simplest, most reliable defense.

defensePackages.label: Survive by being hard to hit.
defensePackages.explanation: Enemies miss more often. You dodge instead of soaking hits.

defensePackages.label: Cut a percentage off incoming damage.
defensePackages.explanation: Percentage Damage Reduction on hits that get through.

defensePackages.label: Ignore a few hits completely.
defensePackages.explanation: A limited number of hits per combat simply miss you.

defensePackages.label: Spend a pool to strip Attack Dice before they roll.
defensePackages.explanation: Enter Parry instead of attacking and spend pool 1:1 to remove Attack Dice.

defensePackages.label: Spend a combat reserve of Damage Dice before damage is rolled.
defensePackages.explanation: A closed reserve of Damage Dice you spend to cancel incoming damage.

offensePackages.label: I want to move enemies around and punish movement.
offensePackages.explanation: Lacerate punishes enemies for moving. Push forces enemies into bad positions. Together they create a simple control plan.
offensePackages.warning: This package works best when you understand positioning.

offensePackages.label: I want enemies to take damage over time.
offensePackages.explanation: Ruin is simple and self-contained. You hit the enemy, the enemy takes ongoing damage, and the effect keeps applying pressure.

offensePackages.label: I want to slow enemies down.
offensePackages.explanation: Slow makes enemies slower and punishes standing still.

offensePackages.label: I want enemies to be easier to hit.
offensePackages.explanation: Expose reduces enemy Evade. This helps you and your allies hit fast, slippery, or hard-to-hit enemies.

offensePackages.label: I want to break armor and then hit hard.
offensePackages.explanation: Corrode reduces Armor. It is a setup tool. It becomes useful when you follow up with meaningful damage.
offensePackages.warning: Do not choose Corrode alone. Corrode wants a damage follow-up.

offensePackages.label: I want my group to focus one important enemy.
offensePackages.explanation: Mark helps identify and pressure a priority target.

offensePackages.label: I want to curse enemies so Spells hit harder.
offensePackages.explanation: Hex supports Spell damage. Follow up with a Spell or weapon attack of your choice on the review step.
offensePackages.warning: Hex is weak without a damage follow-up.

offensePackages.label: I want to cut enemy dice pools (Weaken).
offensePackages.explanation: Weaken removes dice from Might / Agility / Intellect pools. Pair it with follow-up attacks that use those Attributes.
offensePackages.warning: Weaken does not reduce Attributes, Keep, or Damage Pools — only rolled pools.

offensePackages.label: I just want a reliable attack.
offensePackages.explanation: This is the simplest offensive option. You hit the enemy and deal damage without extra condition tracking.

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Damage
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: The simplest offensive buff — your weapon and power hits deal extra damage every time they land.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Your attacks deal +9d8 damage while the buff is active.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Critical
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Your maintained offensive buff grants Critical(1–4) at milestone ranks. No bonus damage, penetration, or other filler — Critical only.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Gain Critical(1) (1 designated roll per combat; natural 7s and 8s explode).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Maximization
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Spend combat-wide uses to maximize one Damage or Healing Roll (artificial 8s). Independent of Passive/Stone Maximization.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: While maintained, you may Maximization 1 eligible Damage or Healing Roll per combat (entire shared roll becomes artificial 8s; no explosions).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Damage Aura
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: End-of-turn damage pulse against nearby enemies while maintained.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: At the end of each of your turns, enemies within 2 m take 3d8 damage.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Summon Damage Aura
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Your own Summons deal extra damage while fighting inside your bonded aura.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Own Summons within 14 m gain +2d8 Damage on their attacks.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Allied Damage Aura
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Other allied non-Summons in your aura gain bonus damage dice on their attacks — not you or Summons.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Other allied non-Summon creatures within 2 m gain +1d8 on their eligible damaging Martial/Spell Attacks (highest same-name aura wins; not you or Summons).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Armor Reduction Aura
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Hostile creatures in your aura take Armor reduction against your and your allies' eligible attacks.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Hostile creatures within 2 m have 4 less effective Armor against eligible damaging Martial/Spell Attacks by you or your allies (highest same-name aura wins).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Thorns
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: When you take final HP damage, retaliate with Thorns dice (capped by the loss).
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Gain Thorns 4d8. When you take final HP damage, deal that much (capped by the loss) to the source.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Armor Reduction
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Your own eligible attacks ignore printed Armor (not Damage Reduction, not Corrode).
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Your eligible damaging Martial and Spell Attacks ignore 17 Armor (effective Armor floors at 0).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Enemy Evade Reduction
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Your Martial Attack Rolls treat each target's Evade as lower — does not change stored Evade or Spell TN.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Against your eligible Martial Attack Rolls, each target's effective Evade is reduced by 4 (floor 0). No effect on Spell TN.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Spell Resistance Piercing
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Your Spells ignore a portion of target Spell Resistance. Base Spell TN and Paid Raises stay intact.
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Your Spells ignore 4 Spell Resistance on each target (SR floors at 0). Base Spell TN and Paid Raises are unchanged.
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

offensiveActiveBuffs.label: Area Expansion
offensiveActiveBuffs.explanation: Expand your instantaneous circular AoE radius. Anti-stacks with Intellect Stone AoE radius (take the larger).
offensiveActiveBuffs.rankPreview: Your eligible instantaneous circular AoEs gain +1 m radius (larger of this or Intellect Stone AoE radius bonus; do not stack).
offensiveActiveBuffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).
